title: My stats
subtitle: Your games, your champions, your roles.
emptyRoster: This team has no players yet.
footnote: No global average is shown here: it is not available, and inventing one would be worse than doing without. Every figure is compared to your own other games or to your teammates.

locked.title: Link a Riot account to open this screen
locked.description: With no linked account there is nothing to compute: statistics are built from your games, and nothing tells us which ones are yours.

pending.title: Your Riot ID is waiting to be confirmed
pending.description: It is saved, but we could not confirm it with Riot yet. Collection will start as soon as we can.

waiting.title: Your data is on its way
waiting.description: The first pass walks your whole history. It is slow once, and only once.

window.label: Period
window.helper: Every figure on this screen covers that period.
window.bounded: Collected games: each player's last {{maxGames}}, from the last {{maxAgeDays}} days at most. Older history is not collected.
window.boundedUnknown: Only each player's recent games are collected.

coverage.untracked: This account is not collected for itself yet: the known games are those where it met a player we track. The figures are exact, but partial.

delta.versusRest: {{delta}} against the rest of their pool ({{count}} game(s))

section.queuesHelper: Games played per mode. A win in normal draft is not a win in flex.
section.byQueueHelper: The mode excludes nothing: it separates what cannot be compared.
section.presenceHelper: Share of team games each player took part in.
section.presenceRings: Share of team games, and wins when present
section.bySideMap: Green: above your average ({{average}}), red: below
section.trendReferenceTeam: Line: your average over the period ({{value}})
section.trendHelper: Your win rate patch by patch, against your own average. A patch with fewer than 3 games is greyed out: too few games to read a trend.
section.trendReference: Line: your average over the period ({{value}})
section.noPatch: Not enough history yet to draw a trend.

team.definition: A team game: at least {{count}} of the {{roster}} players on the roster, across all queues.
team.gamesHint: {{total}} found, {{undecided}} of them without a shared result
team.truncated: Only the most recent games are shown: the totals cover what is visible here.

games.ranksObserved: Ranks observed on {{date}} — Riot only serves the current rank.
games.rankHint: Average of ranked players ({{count}}); unranked players are not counted.
games.accordionHelper: Click a game to expand it, then a player for their numbers in that game.

COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.short: No Riot account linked: nothing to compute.
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.title: No Riot account linked
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.description: Statistics are built from an account's games. Until a Riot ID is set, there are no games to attach.

INGESTION_EN_COURS.title: Collection is not finished
INGESTION_EN_COURS.description: The history is still being built. It is slow once, and only once: figures will appear as it goes.

AUCUNE_PARTIE.title: No game
AUCUNE_PARTIE.description: Everything is collected and there is nothing to count over this period. That is not a failure: widen the period to look further back.

EFFECTIF_INCOMPLET.title: Not enough Riot accounts on the roster
EFFECTIF_INCOMPLET.description: A team game needs at least four players present. While fewer than four members have a linked Riot account, no game can be recognised as a team game.

CONNECTEUR_INDISPONIBLE.title: Figures unavailable
CONNECTEUR_INDISPONIBLE.description: The Riot connector is not answering. Nothing is lost — but while it is silent we cannot claim anything, and showing zero would be wrong.

radar.title: Profile
radar.helper: Ten axes, further out = better, read against the chosen reference: the centre is its low end, the edge its high end. Dotted: the average player of every tier in this position.

note.met: As {{position}}, {{games}} game(s). Centre: 5th percentile of {{count}} direct opponents (at least {{min}} games each), edge: 95th.
note.league: In the {{position}} role, {{games}} game(s). Each axis is your percentile among {{count}} {{tier}} players in that role, patches {{patches}}: centre 0, edge 100.

empty.noGames: No Summoner's Rift game over the period.
empty.met: Not enough known direct opponents as {{position}} yet: ten are needed, with at least five games each. The reference grows with collection.
empty.leagueThin: No {{tier}} reference in the {{position}} role yet: it is computed daily from the ranked players collected.
empty.unranked: Unranked player: no tier to compare with.

scope.rift: Figures computed on Summoner's Rift (ranked, normals, Clash): ARAM and Arena would skew per-minute numbers.

players.filterHint: Click an avatar to keep only some players.
players.radarHint: Pick {{count}} players at most to see their radar profiles side by side.

detail.matchupsHelper: Our player against their counterpart. Rank gap in divisions (solo, else flex), and the lane state at 15 minutes.
detail.noTimeline: Timeline being collected: the 15-minute numbers will come with it.
detail.noMatchups: Members on both sides: no matchups.
detail.loadFailed: The game details could not be loaded.
detail.shortGame: Game over before 15 minutes: there is no 15-minute lane state.
detail.playerHint: Click a player: their numbers in this game, their average and the rank they match.

opposition.title: How far the team wins
opposition.intro: Win rate by opponent level. Ranks are those observed at collection: for an old game, that is today's rank.
opposition.coverage: {{withRanks}} of {{games}} game(s) have ranks; median observation {{lag}} day(s) after the game.
opposition.byTierHelper: Solo, else flex; average of ranked opponents.
opposition.byGapHelper: Our average minus theirs, in divisions.
opposition.ceilingValue: Highest opponent tier held at 50% or more: {{tier}}
opposition.ceilingNone: No opponent tier held at 50% over {{count}} games or more.
opposition.ceilingHelper: At least {{count}} games in the tier.
opposition.byPositionHelper: Each member's direct counterpart. A lane won: more gold than them at 15 minutes.
opposition.pending: Opponent ranks are being collected: this section will fill in as collection goes.

refresh.done_one: New games requested for {{count}} player: they will appear as collection proceeds.
refresh.done_other: New games requested for {{count}} players: they will appear as collection proceeds.
refresh.tooSoon: An update was just requested: try again in a few minutes.

early.title: Early game, 0 to 15 min
early.helper: A gank is the jungler coming to an enemy lane. It is seen through a kill in the lane, or on each one-minute timeline frame: a visit without a kill between two frames is missed.
early.weakSummary: Our jungler played {{side}}; {{onWeak}} of {{total}} enemy gank(s) landed on the other side.
early.balancedSummary: Our jungler split their time between both sides.

objectives.title: Objectives before 15 min: us on the left, them on the right

early.noAnalysis: No early-game analysis: missing timeline, or unknown roles in this game.

team.helper: Over {{count}} team game(s) with an analysed timeline. Ganks without a kill are only seen on one-minute frames: they are undercounted.
team.none: No analysed team game over the period.
team.lanersHelper: Held: the targeted player did not die during the gank.
team.junglersHelper: Decisive: a kill without loss, or an objective on that lane’s side within 90 seconds. Presence: the share of their time, from 2 to 14 min, spent on the side of the map where that teammate played, over their shared games. ADC and support share the bottom side.
team.sidesHelper: The side where they spent at least two more minutes. Weak side: the other one.
team.sidesMap: Win rate by our jungler's strong side (average: {{average}}). Green: above our average, red: below, grey: fewer than 3 games.
team.goldTitle: Gold at 15 min, then at the end
team.goldNoEnd: The end of game is not recorded yet.
team.goldWorse: The gap widens after 15 min: your late game costs more than your early game.
team.goldBetter: You claw back after 15 min: the late game carries you.
team.goldSteady: The gap barely moves after 15 min.
team.lanersConclusion: You hold {{held}} of the ganks you face. Most exposed: {{player}}, {{deaths}} death per game to a gank.
team.junglerConclusion_one: {{player}}: {{made}} gank per game, {{decisive}} decisive, over {{count}} game.
team.junglerConclusion_other: {{player}}: {{made}} ganks per game, {{decisive}} decisive, over {{count}} games.
team.sideConclusion: You win {{rate}} when your jungler plays {{side}} ({{count}} games).

proximity.helper: Share of minutes within 2,000 units (about one screen), on each minute's snapshot. A minute does not count if either player is dead or at their fountain. A roam is leaving the ADC between two minutes.
proximity.adc_one: With the ADC: {{share}} of minutes before 15 min, {{count}} roam.
proximity.adc_other: With the ADC: {{share}} of minutes before 15 min, {{count}} roams.
proximity.adcNone: With the ADC: too few minutes counted before 15 min.
proximity.jungler: With the jungler: {{share}} of minutes after 15 min.
proximity.junglerNone: With the jungler: too few minutes counted after 15 min.
proximity.closest: Most often near {{position}}: {{share}} of the game's minutes.

family.title: My game, analysed
family.helper: Each figure against {{tier}} players in the {{position}} role, on their averages. The gauge shows the share it beats; the emblem, the tier it is closest to when the stat rises with rank.
family.helperNoTier: With no known rank or main role, the figures stand alone: no gauge, no emblem.
family.laningBasis: Differences against the direct opponent, over {{count}} game(s) with a timeline.
family.laningNone: No game with a timeline in this period yet.
family.supportBasis: Over {{early}} game(s) with a timeline before 15 min, {{late}} after.
family.supportNone: No support game with a timeline over the period.

grade.level: {{tier}} level in the {{position}} role: the value is closest to their per-game average ({{mean}}).
grade.noRank: No tier for this stat: it barely changes from one rank to the next, since everyone plays against their own level — or the sample is still too thin.
grade.inTier: Better than {{rank}}% of {{tier}} players in the {{position}} role ({{count}} players).
grade.inTierGame: Better than {{rank}}% of {{tier}} games in the {{position}} role.
grade.basis: Based on your games in the {{position}} role, compared with ranked players on patches {{patches}}.
grade.champion: Better than {{rank}}% of {{champion}} players in {{group}}, on their averages ({{count}} players with 5+ games).
grade.championFallback: Not enough {{champion}} players in {{group}} yet: compared with all {{tier}} players in the {{position}} role.
grade.team: Averaged over {{games}} game(s): better than {{rank}}% of games at the same tier.
grade.teamLevel: Average at {{tier}} level: closest to their per-game average.
grade.missing: Tier averages not available yet: the sample of ranked players used to compute them is still being collected.

teamLevel.title: Early versus Late
teamLevel.helper: The early game mostly measures each player’s level in lane, the late game the team play. The gap tells which of the two carries you. The emblem places the 15-min value among ranked games of the same tier.
teamLevel.empty: No team game with a timeline in this period yet.
teamLevel.endPending_one: End of game over {{count}} game out of {{games}}: the others are waiting to be recomputed.
teamLevel.endPending_other: End of game over {{count}} games out of {{games}}: the others are waiting to be recomputed.

history.title: My games
history.helper: All queues, most recent first. A game's ranks and timeline are collected when you open it.
history.truncated: The {{count}} most recent games out of {{total}} in the period.

playerGame.title: {{player}} in this game
playerGame.averageBasis_one: Average over {{count}} game as {{position}}, over the selected period.
playerGame.averageBasis_other: Average over {{count}} games as {{position}}, over the selected period.
playerGame.noAverage: No average: no Summoner's Rift game at this position over the period.
playerGame.tier: Rank held at the time of the game: {{tier}}.
playerGame.tierEstimated: Rank estimated from the game's lobby: {{tier}}.
playerGame.noMetrics: This game's numbers are not computed yet.
playerGame.rankHelper: Rank: the tier whose per-game average, in the same role, is closest to the value — only for stats that rise with rank. The others (KDA, deaths, 15-minute differences…) are given as “top x%” of your tier. A dash: not enough games yet to tell.

trend.up: Improving: {{now}} this month, versus {{before}} the month before.
trend.down: Slipping: {{now}} this month, versus {{before}} the month before.
trend.stable: Steady: {{now}} this month, {{before}} the month before.

synergy.title: Duos and resources
synergy.noNotable: No pair wins 5 points more or less than expected together.
synergy.duosHint: Each cell, over team games: on top, each player’s win rate in games without the other (average of both); below, the pair’s win rate when playing together, green 5 points above or more, orange 5 points below or more, grey in between; then the number of games together. “Apart: —”: they never play without each other. Pairs with at least {{count}} games together.
synergy.noDuo: No pair has {{count}} team games together in this period yet.
synergy.duoUp_one: {{a}} and {{b}} win {{points}} points more than expected together ({{count}} game).
synergy.duoUp_other: {{a}} and {{b}} win {{points}} points more than expected together ({{count}} games).
synergy.duoDown_one: {{a}} and {{b}} win {{points}} points less than expected together ({{count}} game).
synergy.duoDown_other: {{a}} and {{b}} win {{points}} points less than expected together ({{count}} games).
synergy.resourcesHint: Roles ranked by gold priority: the win-rate gap between games where the role has more than its usual share of the team’s gold and games where it has less. All queues.
synergy.noResources: No team game in this period yet.
synergy.notConverting: Gets more gold than it returns in damage.
synergy.findings: What stands out for the team
synergy.above_one: Over {{threshold}} of the gold: {{rate}} wins ({{count}} game)
synergy.above_other: Over {{threshold}} of the gold: {{rate}} wins ({{count}} games)
synergy.noSplit: Not enough games to split above and below.
synergy.correlation: This is a correlation, not a cause: a gold share is relative. A role can exceed its threshold because the others are behind.

closeness.title: Who plays near whom
closeness.hint: For each player, the share of minutes spent within 2,000 units of each teammate, over their team games with a timeline. A minute does not count if either is dead or at their fountain. A bar from {{count}} shared games.
closeness.none: No team game with a timeline over this period.
closeness.noMate: No shared game with a timeline.
closeness.noPair_one: No pair has {{count}} shared game with a timeline yet.
closeness.noPair_other: No pair has {{count}} shared games with a timeline yet.
closeness.tightestText_one: {{a}} and {{b}} play together: {{early}} of the time before 15 min, {{late}} after, over {{count}} game.
closeness.tightestText_other: {{a}} and {{b}} play together: {{early}} of the time before 15 min, {{late}} after, over {{count}} games.
closeness.apartText: {{name}} is near each teammate {{share}} of the time on average. Closest to {{mate}} ({{mateShare}}).
closeness.regroupText: Two teammates are together {{early}} of the time before 15 min, {{late}} after.

premade.summary_one: {{count}} team game in the period (at least {{minimum}} members together). Each tile reads: on the left the player (premade value, then the gap with their usual stats), on the right the team (the gap with the teammates' average, then their rank).
premade.summary_other: {{count}} team games in the period (at least {{minimum}} members together). Each tile reads: on the left the player (premade value, then the gap with their usual stats), on the right the team (the gap with the teammates' average, then their rank).
premade.unknown: The number of team games is unavailable for now.
premade.none: No team game in the period: nothing to compare.

hint.self: Gap with their own stats, all games in the period
hint.teammates: Gap with the other members' average, in premade
hint.rank_one: Rank among members with team games
hint.rank_other: Rank among the {{count}} members with team games

radar.note: Centre: the lowest member, edge: the highest, in premade. Dotted: the members' average.
radar.fewMembers: At least two members with team games are needed.

verdict.neutralHint: Neither good nor bad: this measure depends on the role played (a tank takes damage, that is the job).

highlights.title: What stands out
highlights.noTier: Without a rank or main role, no tier comparison.

champion.versusRest: {{delta}} win rate compared with their other champions ({{count}} games).

premadeHighlights.title: What stands out for the team
premadeHighlights.method: Each player compared with their own games, over the period, from {{count}} team games. A rate counts in points (from 5), a ratio as a share of its value (from 15%).

backfill.listing: Catching up your history since {{date}}: listing your games.
backfill.progress_one: Catching up your history: {{collected}} game out of {{count}}, back to {{date}}.
backfill.progress_other: Catching up your history: {{collected}} games out of {{count}}, back to {{date}}.

deaths.low: You play it safe: {{value}} deaths per game, fewer than in {{share}} of {{position}} games.

kills.low: You kill little: {{value}} kills per game, fewer than in {{share}} of {{position}} games.

kda.low: Your {{value}} KDA is below {{share}} of {{position}} games.

distribution.aria: {{metric}}: spread of {{position}} games, your average at {{value}}.

roles.title: Who supports whom
roles.intro_one: By position, whoever plays it, over {{count}} team game with a timeline and our five positions known.
roles.intro_other: By position, whoever plays it, over {{count}} team games with a timeline and our five positions known.
roles.none: No team game with a timeline and our five positions known over this period.
roles.method: Alone: no teammate within 2,000 units on the minute's frame (deaths and fountain visits left out). Present at an objective: the killer, those who hit it, and those within 3,000 units of the pit on the frame before or after. Present at a fight: involved in a kill, or within 2,000 units on the closest frame if it is within 20 s. Positions are only known once a minute: these are orders of magnitude.
roles.lowFights_one: {{count}} fight in their jungle: {{minimum}} needed to conclude.
roles.lowFights_other: {{count}} fights in their jungle: {{minimum}} needed to conclude.
